description: Tajikistan's statistics agency publishes the results of the 2020 Population and Housing Census on a census page, volume by volume, as PDF tables in Tajik and Russian. Volume eight covers the housing stock and housing conditions. Its amenities table counts residential buildings and their residents by access to electricity, electric stoves, network and bottled gas, heating by stove or electric equipment, water from a communal or individual piped system, an outside standpipe or a well, spring or borehole, sewerage and hot water, split into individual houses, seasonal homes, multi-apartment buildings and dormitories. Nationally about 1.26 million residential buildings reported amenities, of which about 13,400 had network gas and about 490,000 used bottled gas. Other tables give building type and ownership, floor area, and outer wall and roof materials by construction period. The tables run for the republic and its regions, urban and rural. Coverage is national. Format and access: free PDF per table, no registration. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0 (stat.tj: all site materials under CC BY 4.0). Caveats: the text is bilingual Tajik and Russian in PDF layout, and figures must be transcribed. Simulation uses: wall and roof materials by construction period for earthquake exposure, and gas, heating and water supply for winter energy and water planning. Related records: IPUMS International.
